mapper.select: SELECT c.subject_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.name_cn, ''), s.name) AS subject_name, c.ep_status AS current_ep_status, MAX(CASE WHEN e.sort = FLOOR(e.sort) THEN CAST(e.sort AS SIGNED) END) AS target_ep_status, s.eps AS total_episodes FROM user_collection c JOIN subject s ON s.id = c.subject_id JOIN episode e ON e.subject_id = c.subject_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.type = 3 AND e.type = 0 AND e.airdate BETWEEN #{weekStart} AND #{cutoffDate} GROUP BY c.subject_id, s.name_cn, s.name, c.ep_status, s.eps HAVING target_ep_status > c.ep_status ORDER BY c.subject_id
